name: explainer-video
description: Create animated, camera-zooming product explainer & launch videos with voiceover, music, and synced sound effects. Interactive end-to-end skill, plus the motion-graphics super-skill: a named platter of ~56 reusable motion moves across 8 families (text-motion, backgrounds-gradients, element-motion, glass-cards, product-motion, scene-transitions, ui-data-motion, aesthetic-presets) with a drop-in motion.css/motion.js library — plus smooth-render (non-choppy HTML→MP4), vo-sync (word-timestamp cue sync), and audio-stems (separate music/SFX/VO tracks).
